document_type: US prescribing information and patient information
indications_adults: Acute bacterial exacerbations of chronic bronchitis
Uncomplicated skin and skin structure infections
indications_pediatrics: Acute otitis media (6 months and older)
adult_dosage_examples: 500 mg on Day 1, followed by 250 mg once daily on Days 2 through 5 for several listed infections
500 mg once daily for 3 days for acute bacterial sinusitis
Single 1 g dose for chancroid and non-gonococcal urethritis/cervicitis
Single 2 g dose for gonococcal urethritis/cervicitis
pediatric_dosage_examples: Acute otitis media: 30 mg/kg single dose, or 10 mg/kg daily for 3 days, or 10 mg/kg on Day 1 then 5 mg/kg/day on Days 2 through 5
Acute bacterial sinusitis: 10 mg/kg once daily for 3 days
Community-acquired pneumonia: 10 mg/kg on Day 1 then 5 mg/kg once daily on Days 2 through 5
Pharyngitis/tonsillitis: 12 mg/kg once daily for 5 days
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to azithromycin, erythromycin, any macrolide or ketolide
History of cholestatic jaundice/hepatic dysfunction associated with prior azithromycin use
important_warnings: Infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis reported in neonates
QT prolongation and torsades de pointes
Potential cardiovascular death risk described in observational studies
drug_interactions_highlighted: Nelfinavir: monitor for adverse reactions such as liver enzyme abnormalities and hearing impairment
Warfarin: may increase coagulation times; monitor prothrombin time
storage: The patient information states storage at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F).
